Hi Sophie, Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to understand Acme's priorities around latency SLOs, multi-tenant isolation, and the compliance constraints for your EU and APAC teams. Quick recap and suggested next steps below.

What we heard
- Primary use: customer support assistant (live chat + post-chat summarization) with peak concurrency during EMEA mornings and APAC evenings.
- Critical: sub-100ms p95 for short responses, audit logs retained for 7 years, and SOC2 evidence for procurement.
- Timeline: evaluating vendors now, aiming for a pilot in Q2.

Recommended next step
- Technical deep dive (60–90 min) with Aditya (solutions) to walk through architecture, integration points, security controls, and a short live demo of end-to-end inference with sample traffic.

Scheduling notes + proposal
- We want to make scheduling painless for multi-region stakeholders. To avoid repeating the same local time every week (which biases one region), we propose a rotating weekly slot pattern so US/EU/APAC each get at least one convenient window in the first three weeks of the pilot schedule.

Suggested rotating slots (examples, all shown with local equivalents):
1) US-friendly window (Week A) — 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 18:00 UTC
2) EU-friendly window (Week B) — 15:00 CET / 14:00 UTC / 10:00 ET
3) APAC-friendly window (Week C) — 09:00 SGT / 11:00 AEST / 01:00 UTC

If that approach sounds good, please pick the slot that works best for your broader team and we can lock it in. I created a short Calendly page with our preferred windows to simplify pickings: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/technical-deep-dive?month=2027-03

Attachments: Redwood-Discovery-Deck.pdf (high-level deck) — sending the technical agenda in a follow-up from Aditya.

Proposed immediate actions
- Sophie/Tom: indicate preferred week/slot or pick a time via Calendly.
- Aditya: run the technical deep dive and review integration checklist.
- Camila: once a slot is selected, Camila will send the calendar invite and include the internal technical invite list.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing this.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Rotating schedule proposal (operational detail) — for a 3-week pilot cadence, rotate the primary meeting window each week so stakeholders in each region occasionally get a convenient live slot:
- Week 1: US primary (e.g., 10:00 PT)
- Week 2: EU primary (e.g., 15:00 CET)
